text:
maya: PM posted for the 2026-03-20 inference blip. Need to translate remediation items into test additions and clear owners. Short thread to assign tasks and deadlines.
owen: Read it. Two must-haves: a unit/regression for prefix-cache edge condition and a small integration that simulates cached vs uncached prefixes. I can take the unit/regression test.
li: I'll pick up a repeatable load/soak job to reproduce the short-request burst pattern. Thinking k6 in CI + a Grafana dashboard. ETA: 5 business days.
samar: Noticed similar incidents over last 3 months point to KV eviction bursts when replicas are autoscaled down then up. Propose a focused chaos experiment: soft kill one replica repeatedly during a 2m burst and verify fallback routing and cache repopulation.
eva: I will own the prompt-set expansion. Plan to produce ~60 triggers that hit long-tail cache-miss behaviors and also cover model-swap output checks. ETA: 7 days.
maya: Cool. Please write timelines here and link PRs/issues. We want a staging canary before next deploy.
owen: Plan: PR with unit/regression by EOD Thursday (1799999999 + 4 days). Include integration harness that runs in staging CI.
li: Load job plan sketch:
```
name: incident-burst-load
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * 2' # weekly
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/run_k6.sh --script k6/burst_short_requests.js --rate 10000
```
li: Aim to have action + dashboard + alert mapping by next Tuesday.
samar: Chaos drill: I'll run a tabletop on Monday and a live staged run on Wednesday 11am PT. Owner: samar. Success criteria: routing fallback within 30s, error spike <3x baseline, 95p latency < 2x baseline.
oncall-bot: Incident PM-2026-03-20 linked: https://pm.redwood/company/PM-4567
owen: Also adding a micro-eval to the regression that asserts no quality drop when we fallback to model-variant-b. I'll pair with eva on thresholds.
eva: Will push prompt sets to github.com/redwood-inference/evals/prompt-sets/pm-4567-cache-edge and include small eval harness and pass criteria.
maya: Owners and deadlines recap:
- Regression unit + integration: owen 179 by Thu
- Load/soak k6 job + dashboard: li 179 by next Tue
- Prompt-set augmentation + evals: eva 179 by 7 days
- Chaos tabletop + staging run: samar 179 next Wed 11am PT
- Model-swap micro-eval: owen + eva 179 with regression
maya: Also ask eng-sre to add a monthly KV-eviction alert rule and a dashboard panel for recurrent spikes. @li can you coordinate?
li: I'll file an ops-ticket and sync with eng-sre. Will include sample query and threshold suggestions.
owen: I'll create GH issue linking PM and tests: labels [incident-regression, action-needed]. Drop a short comment when you open your PRs so the weekly follow-up can count progress.
eva: PR will include expected metrics and a small baseline dataset.
samar: I'll draft the chaos playbook and share in #eng-oncall; will also update the runbook if the stage run finds gaps.
maya: Thanks. Let's reconvene in the weekly follow-up on Friday 9am PT to review canary/staging results. If anything blocks, escalate here with quick status. :thumbsup:
